'''Words of banishment''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] used by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Samuro]] to [[Prisoner/Legends|imprison]] the [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] [[Rajine]] hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but had to sacrifice [[Gender/Legends|his]] life to do so. Many [[Standard year|years]] later, when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] [[Mission to Rajine's planet|arrived]] on Rajine's world searching for missing [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], he encountered [[Countess/Legends|Countess]] Rajine, who proceeded to capture the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The droid [[Z-18]], who used to serve Samuro, helped Mace escape and gave him the Jedi's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. With this [[Samuro's Jedi holocron|device]] Mace, along with the essence of Samuro, was able to free the life forces of Rajine's victims by speaking the words of banishment, the [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] then turned against the Countess.<ref name="NWO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Words of banishment first appeared in ''[[No Way Out]]'',<ref name="NWO" /> a [[2007]] story in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9|ninth volume]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novels]]<ref name="Amazon">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-623/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-9|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9}}</ref> written by the [[Fillbach Brothers]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="NWO" />

The Words appear on Mace's speech balloon in some alien font and are untranslated in the dialogue. the alien font is the same as the one used later in [[Chain of Command (comic story)|"Chain of Command"]] for the [[Hitakan language]].<ref>{{CWACite|10|Chain of Command (comic story)}}</ref>
